note: T3 tracking-policy scenarios; declared instructions, not observed agent behavior.

input.before: Author A owns task T1 through attempt a1 at SHA S1; no completion delivery was observed.
input.event: Persisted task_status shows completed, result_available, hasPendingChildRuns:false and AXSTACK-DONE at S2; driver isolation checks agree.

expected.after: The whole a1 delivery is consumed, its identity and S2 are verified, and eligible dependent work may advance.
actions: match sender, T1, and a1 before advancement
forbidden: treat settled status alone as completion
advance only part of the delivery

input.before: task T1 has a current APPROVE receipt for SHA S3; dependent task T2 remains pending.
input.event: A valid a1 completion delivery wakes the driver.

expected.after: The exact review receipt, authority, and dependencies are verified; ready T2 advances under a new authoritative attempt.
actions: verify SHA, review receipt, authority, and dependency readiness
create one attempt only if every gate is satisfied

input.before: Delivery E1 already advanced T2 and its receipt is recorded.
input.event: The same a1 AXSTACK-DONE delivery arrives again.

expected.after: The duplicate is deduplicated by runtime identity and recorded state remains single and consistent.
actions: reconcile E1 against the run record

input.before: task T3 has one attempt a3 and no verified agent turn.
input.event: t3_thread_launch returned preparing; thread inspection reveals a permission prompt before any verified active run.

expected.after: a3 remains the sole pending attempt and startup is held for the user.
actions: record input acceptance separately from run start

input.before: Driver C1 is consuming a4 but native thread/run identity disagrees with its record.
input.event: Native inspection reveals a threadId/runId mismatch with the recorded driver identity.

expected.after: C1 stops consuming, preserves the whole delivery, and reconciles the recorded driver identity before advancement.
actions: preserve the whole delivery as evidence
stop consuming and reconcile recorded driver identity through t3-runtime.md

input.before: A resumed run records active task T5, attempt a5, thread A, and remaining scope.
input.event: The driver restarts and resumes execution.

expected.after: a5 and thread A are reconciled and retained when runtime state agrees; no second writer is created.
actions: repair only stale derived fields from receipts

input.before: Author A remains recorded active with no verified progress across expected checkpoints.
input.event: Runtime inspection observes unchanged Git and ambiguous session state.

expected.after: Hold unsafe advancement and reconcile the same T3 attempt through t3_thread_read and terminal evidence.
actions: verify session, SHA, receipts, and ownership

input.before: Thread A belongs to settled attempt a6.

expected.after: Thread A is retained for the user and excluded from reuse or cleanup.

input.before: task T7 moved from failed attempt a7 to authorized retry a8.
input.event: A late valid AXSTACK-DONE for a7 arrives while a8 is active.

expected.after: The a7 receipt is recorded as late evidence but cannot complete a8 or T7.

input.before: The user explicitly requested full transfer from owner O1 to recipient O2 and the exact handoff record is prepared.
input.event: O2 explicitly accepts the recorded scope, revisions, authority, and pending request.

expected.after: Ownership transfers only for the accepted boundary and O1 stops.
actions: validate acceptance against the intended handoff

input.before: One finite-session peer-review manager prompt and schedule are configured but remain disabled.
input.event: Source checks pass, while fresh-session launch, overlapping-pass behavior, session-loss recovery, and total process and memory effects have no live receipts.

expected.after: Activation remains unverified and disabled while repository delivery may continue.
actions: record the four live evidence gaps
run only a separately authorized bounded native canary before activation
forbidden: infer runtime behavior from prompt text
build a precheck, watchdog, scheduler, or queue engine

input.before: Author A is idle with no matching AXSTACK-DONE and the candidate revision is unchanged.
input.event: The driver reconciles task, attempt key, thread and run.

expected.after: A remains incomplete until a matching delivery and required evidence verify completion.
actions: record the unresolved state and next action
forbidden: mark A complete because it is idle

input.before: Author A produced candidate S8 and remains usable; review requests an authorized repair.
input.event: The driver prepares the fix loop.

expected.after: Repair returns to A with t3_thread_send mode=queue in the same attempt and worktree.
actions: verify A's session, worktree, and provenance
bind the repair to the existing owner and scope
forbidden: launch a different author without a valid recovery need
